generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the broadleaf base: it gives the values its species leave unset, which the broadleaf program gave as defaults until then.

traits.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), families 48 Caprifoliaceae, 312 Valerianaceae and 313 Dipsacaceae, which APG joins as Caprifoliaceae (Sambucus and Viburnum go to Viburnaceae): leaves opposite, simple or deeply divided; flowers mostly in cymes, in heads in the teasels. The order's file states the opposite leaves, the missing stipules and the inferior ovary.

traits.flower_symmetry.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data), family Caprifoliaceae with Carlemanniaceae, Dipsacaceae, Morinaceae, Sambucaceae, Valerianaceae: flowers regular or irregular as coded, a state the authors qualify keeping its word (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py).

traits.zygomorphy.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data), family Caprifoliaceae with Carlemanniaceae, Dipsacaceae, Morinaceae, Sambucaceae, Valerianaceae: its irregular flowers are of no named kind (pea flower, two lips, orchid lip), read from the coded corolla symmetry (spec-rework/b1/delta): zygomorphy other.
